entries.c1814d1701f86db3: In the previous medium-term management plan period (the five years through the fiscal year ended March 2024), it actively pursued M&A of niche-top companies centered on manufacturing, working to build a stable business portfolio to replace its founding coal business. The Management Strategy 2024, announced in May 2024 for the three years through the fiscal year ending March 2027, set out active M&A investment and shareholder returns, and it achieved its original plan one year ahead of schedule. From the fiscal year ending March 2027 onward, under the Medium-Term Management Plan 2030 newly formulated in May 2026, it will continue to pursue M&A of niche-top companies with strong technical capabilities, and it states its aim as “a group of companies that protects and nurtures manufacturing in Japan for the next 100 years.” Its basic policy on shareholder returns is “progressive dividends.” As issues for each segment, it cites monitoring the supply and price trends of energy and raw materials for Consumer Goods and Industrial Products, and maintaining appropriate interest margins in line with interest rate trends for Finance and Other.
